name: Twotrees ED1
notes: EU store pre-order price, Standard package (Super Early Bird tier = USD 2,299; announced to rise to USD 2,399 after 28 Sep 2026; strike-through price €3,939.95). Full payment required, shipping from November 2026; the store does not state that VAT/import duties are included. All-in-One package (€2,416.95) adds 4th axis, vise and edge finder. Footprint depth 630 mm with touchscreen unfolded (557 mm folded). Max acceleration 200 mm/s². Spindle cooling and collet type not specified. Optional 10 W quick-change laser module mentioned but not yet listed in the store.

accessories.name: Twotrees 4th Axis CNC Rotary Module Kit for ED1
accessories.description: Harmonic-reducer rotary axis (max Ø50 × 100 mm) for cylindrical and multi-sided machining; pre-sale.

accessories.name: Twotrees Dust Collector M3 for ED1
accessories.description: External dust collector with adjustable airflow that captures chips at the source; pre-sale.

accessories.name: Twotrees 3D Wired Probe for ED1
accessories.description: Wired 3D probe that locates workpiece edges and centres to 0.01 mm; pre-sale.

accessories.name: Twotrees Aluminum Vise Bench Clamp for ED1
accessories.description: Rigid aluminium vise with up to 200 × 120 mm clamping range for tight-tolerance parts; pre-sale.
